basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full dose of Phosphorus (DAP 65 kg or SSP 188 kg) + 1/4th Nitrogen (Urea 25 kg) + 1/3rd Potash (MOP 17 kg) applied in furrow at sowing.
top_dressing_schedule: Apply Nitrogen and Potash in 3 equal splits: 1st split at 20-25 DAS (squaring initiation), 2nd split at 45-50 DAS (peak squaring), 3rd split at 70-75 DAS (boll formation).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.magnesium_deficiency: Reddening of lower leaves (leaf reddening) between veins while veins remain green. Correction: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4) @ 10 g/L (1%) + Urea @ 10 g/L at 45 and 65 DAS.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.boron_deficiency: Square dropping, deformed bolls, petiole ring formation. Correction: Soil application of Borax @ 4 kg/acre or foliar spray of Solubor (Boron 20%) @ 1.0 - 1.5 g/L at flowering.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Interveinal chlorosis in young leaves, shortened internodes (little leaf). Correction: Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4 21%) @ 10 kg/acre basal or foliar spray of 2 g/L Chelated Zinc (EDTA-Zn 12%).

biofertilizers_recommended: Azotobacter / Azospirillum @ 500 g/acre + Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) @ 500 g/acre mixed with 100 kg FYM applied near root zone.
citation: PJTSAU Cotton Nutrient Management Package & ICAR-CICR Nagpur 2025

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full dose of Phosphorus (DAP 52 kg) + 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea 26 kg) + 1/2 dose of Potash (MOP 20 kg) incorporated into puddle soil before final leveling.
top_dressing_schedule: Remaining Nitrogen applied in 2 splits: 1st split (Urea 35 kg) at active tillering (20-25 DAT), 2nd split (Urea 35 kg) + remaining Potash (MOP 20 kg) at panicle initiation (45-50 DAT).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency_khaira_disease: Rusty-brown irregular pigmentation appearing on 3rd and 4th leaves 2-3 weeks after transplanting, stunted plant growth with brittle leaves. Correction: Basal soil application of Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 20 kg/acre or foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate @ 2 g/L + 1 g/L slaked lime (twice at 5-day interval).
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_deficiency: Interveinal chlorosis turning into bleached ivory-white leaves in light calcareous soils or dry direct-seeded rice (DSR). Correction: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 10 g/L (1%) + 1 g/L citric acid.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azospirillum @ 1 kg/acre + PSB @ 1 kg/acre + Blue Green Algae (BGA) @ 4 kg/acre or Azolla dual cropping (incorporated at 30 DAT).
citation: ICAR-IIRR Hyderabad Nutrient Bulletin & PJTSAU Vyavasaya Panchangam 2025

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (SSP 200 kg or DAP 70 kg) + 1/5th Nitrogen (Urea 30 kg) + 1/3rd Potash (MOP 27 kg) applied in furrows along with 10 tonnes FYM.
top_dressing_schedule: Apply remaining Nitrogen in 4 equal splits at 30, 60, 90, and 120 DAT. Apply remaining Potash in 2 splits at 60 and 90 DAT.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.calcium_boron_deficiency: Blossom end rot in fruits and terminal bud necrosis. Correction: Foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L + Boron (Solubor) @ 1 g/L at fruit setting.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.magnesium_deficiency: Interveinal yellowing of mature lower leaves. Correction: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate @ 5 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: VAM (Vesicular Arbuscular Mycorrhiza) @ 2 kg/acre in nursery + Azotobacter @ 1 kg/acre mixed with compost.
citation: PJTSAU Spices Agronomy Guide & ICAR-IIHR Bengaluru 2025

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (DAP 100 kg) + 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea 45 kg) + 1/2 Potash (MOP 40 kg) placed 10 cm deep in planting bed.
top_dressing_schedule: Top dress Nitrogen in 2 equal splits at 30 and 45 DAT. Apply remaining Potash at early fruit bulking (45 DAT). In fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 3 kg/acre weekly.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.blossom_end_rot_calcium: Dark, sunken, water-soaked, leathery black spots on blossom end of green fruits caused by localized calcium deficiency under fluctuating soil moisture. Correction: Foliar spray of Calcium Chloride @ 3 g/L or Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L weekly during fruit enlargement.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.boron_deficiency: Fruit cracking, cat-facing, brittle petioles. Correction: Foliar spray of Solubor @ 1 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azotobacter @ 1 kg/acre + PSB @ 1 kg/acre + Trichoderma harzianum @ 1 kg/acre in nursery potting media.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (DAP 52 kg) + Full Potash (MOP 27 kg) + 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 45 kg) drilled through ferti-seed drill at sowing.
top_dressing_schedule: Remaining 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 45 kg) top dressed in 2 equal splits: 1st split (22.5 kg) at Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 21 DAS) just before 1st irrigation; 2nd split (22.5 kg) at maximum tillering / first node stage (40-45 DAS).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.manganese_deficiency: Greyish-pink spots and interveinal chlorosis on middle leaves in light sandy soils under rice-wheat rotation. Correction: Foliar spray of 0.5% Manganese Sulphate (MnSO4 5 g/L) at 30 and 45 DAS.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Brown necrotic spots on middle leaves. Correction: Basal application of Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 10 kg/acre.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azotobacter chroococcum @ 500 g/acre + PSB @ 500 g/acre seed inoculation.
citation: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Wheat Nutrient Management Guide 2025

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (DAP 52 kg) + Full Potash (MOP 33 kg) + 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea 30 kg) placed 5 cm away and below seed.
top_dressing_schedule: Apply remaining Nitrogen in 2 equal splits: 1st split (Urea 35 kg) at knee-high stage (30-35 DAS) followed by earthing up; 2nd split (Urea 35 kg) at tasseling / silking stage (55-60 DAS).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency_white_bud: Bleaching or whitening of upper young leaves ('white bud of maize') starting from base of leaf. Correction: Soil application of 10 kg Zinc Sulphate (21%)/acre basal or foliar spray of Chelated Zinc @ 1 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azospirillum @ 1 kg/acre + PSB @ 1 kg/acre mixed with FYM.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Entire dose of N, P, and K applied as basal at sowing (SSP 150 kg + Urea 20 kg + MOP 33 kg). SSP is mandatory as it provides 16% P2O5 and 12% Sulphur.
top_dressing_schedule: Gypsum application @ 200 kg/acre at pegging stage (40-45 DAS) placed 5-7 cm away from plant rows and incorporated into soil. Gypsum supplies essential Calcium and Sulphur for pod filling and prevents 'pops' (empty pods).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_chlorosis: Complete yellowing to bleaching of young terminal leaves in high pH calcareous black soils. Correction: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 5 g/L + Citric acid @ 1 g/L twice at 7-day interval.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.boron_deficiency_hollow_heart: Internal hollow cavity with dark discoloration inside kernel (hollow heart). Correction: Soil application of Borax @ 4 kg/acre or foliar spray of Solubor @ 1 g/L at 35 DAS.

biofertilizers_recommended: Rhizobium (Bradyrhizobium sp.) @ 250 g / 10 kg seed + PSB @ 250 g/10 kg seed.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full dose of N, P, K applied basal at sowing. Use SSP (Single Super Phosphate) @ 200 kg/acre to meet both Phosphorus and Sulphur requirements + MOP @ 27 kg + Urea @ 15 kg as starter N.
top_dressing_schedule: Soybean fixes its own atmospheric nitrogen through Bradyrhizobium nodulation; no top dressing of urea is needed. Top dress Sulphur through elemental sulphur (10 kg/acre) if SSP was not used.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Yellowing between veins of upper leaves, bronze discoloration. Correction: Basal Zinc Sulphate @ 10 kg/acre or foliar spray of 0.5% ZnSO4.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.molybdenum_deficiency: Poor nodulation and N-deficiency symptoms. Correction: Seed treatment with Sodium Molybdate @ 1 g/kg seed.

biofertilizers_recommended: Bradyrhizobium japonicum @ 5 g/kg seed + PSB @ 5 g/kg seed mandatory.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Entire fertilizer dose applied as basal placement below seed at sowing: DAP @ 45 kg + MOP @ 13 kg per acre.
top_dressing_schedule: Foliar spray of 2% Urea (20 g/L) or 2% DAP at flower bud initiation (70-80 DAS) and repeat 15 days later at peak flowering to reduce flower dropping and boost pod set.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Interveinal chlorosis of middle leaves. Correction: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate @ 2 g/L + lime 1 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: Rhizobium culture @ 200 g / 8 kg seed + PSB culture @ 200 g/8 kg seed.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full dose placed 5-7 cm below seed at sowing using ferti-seed drill: DAP @ 45 kg + MOP @ 13 kg/acre.
top_dressing_schedule: No soil top dressing of nitrogen. Foliar spray of 2% Urea (20 g/L) or 1% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 10 g/L) at pod initiation (65-70 DAS) to enhance seed weight under receding residual moisture.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_deficiency: Yellowing of terminal leaflets in high pH calcareous soils. Correction: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 5 g/L + Citric acid @ 1 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: Mesorhizobium ciceri @ 250 g / 10 kg seed + PSB @ 250 g/10 kg seed.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (SSP 100 kg) + Full Potash (MOP 27 kg) + 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 30 kg) + Sulphur @ 16 kg/acre (through SSP or elemental sulphur).
top_dressing_schedule: Remaining 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 30 kg) top dressed after 1st irrigation at 30-35 DAS (before flowering).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.sulphur_deficiency: Cupping of young leaves, reddish-purple underside pigmentation, reduced pod siliquae formation and lower oil content. Correction: Basal application of Gypsum @ 100 kg/acre or Bentonite Sulphur (90%) @ 10 kg/acre.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.boron_deficiency: Poor pod set, empty siliquae. Correction: Borax @ 4 kg/acre basal.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azotobacter @ 500 g/acre + PSB @ 500 g/acre seed treatment.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Apply 10% Nitrogen (Urea 18 kg) + Full Phosphorus (SSP 200 kg or DAP 70 kg) + 25% Potash (MOP 17 kg) in planting furrow along with 10 tonnes FYM/press mud.
top_dressing_schedule: Apply remaining Nitrogen and Potash in 3 splits: 1st split (20% N + 25% K) at tillering (45 DAP); 2nd split (30% N) at 90 DAP; 3rd split (40% N + 50% K) at final earthing-up (120-150 DAP). Stop all N application after 150 days.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_chlorosis: Interveinal yellow striping of young cane leaves in alkaline soils. Correction: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate @ 10 g/L + Citric acid @ 1 g/L twice at 15-day intervals.
micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Midrib bleaching and stunted internodes. Correction: Basal Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/acre.

biofertilizers_recommended: Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus (endophytic N-fixer) @ 2 kg/acre + PSB @ 2 kg/acre.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (SSP 125 kg) + 1/2 Potash (MOP 27 kg) + 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea 25 kg) + Sulphur (Bentonite-S 10 kg) applied before transplanting.
top_dressing_schedule: Remaining Nitrogen top dressed in 2 equal splits: 1st split (Urea 30 kg) at 30 DAT; 2nd split (Urea 30 kg) + remaining Potash (MOP 27 kg) at 45-50 DAT (bulb initiation). Stop N application after 60 DAT to avoid thick necks.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.zinc_deficiency: Twisting, bending, and inward curling of leaves. Correction: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate @ 2 g/L at 30 and 45 DAT.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azospirillum @ 1 kg/acre + PSB @ 1 kg/acre seedling root dip for 30 minutes.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (DAP 70 kg) + Full Potash (MOP 67 kg or SOP Potassium Sulphate 80 kg for superior chip processing quality) + 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 50 kg) placed in furrows 5 cm away from seed tubers.
top_dressing_schedule: Remaining 1/2 Nitrogen (Urea 50 kg) top dressed at earthing up (30-35 DAP) when plants are 15-20 cm high.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.magnesium_deficiency: Interveinal chlorosis and necrotic brown spotting of lower leaves. Correction: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate @ 5 g/L.

biofertilizers_recommended: Azotobacter @ 1 kg/acre + PSB @ 1 kg/acre tuber slurry treatment.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Full Phosphorus (SSP 150 kg) + 1/4th Nitrogen (Urea 25 kg) + 1/3rd Potash (MOP 20 kg) incorporated into beds along with 10 tonnes FYM + 200 kg neem cake.
top_dressing_schedule: Apply remaining Nitrogen and Potash in 3 equal splits at 40 DAP (1st tillering), 80 DAP (rhizome initiation), and 120 DAP (rhizome development) followed by earthing up and mulching.

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_zinc_deficiency: Chlorosis and pale yellow leaves. Correction: Foliar spray of Micronutrient mixture (Formula 4 / IISR Turmeric special) @ 5 g/L at 60 and 90 DAP.

biofertilizers_recommended: IISR Bio-capsule (Trichoderma + PGPR) @ 1 capsule/100 L water rhizome dip.

basal_dose_kg_per_acre: Entire fertilizer dose applied as basal placement at sowing: DAP @ 35 kg + MOP @ 13 kg/acre.
top_dressing_schedule: Foliar spray of 2% DAP (20 g/L) or 19:19:19 (5 g/L) at flowering (30-35 DAS) and pod setting (45 DAS).

micronutrient_deficiencies_and_correctio.iron_chlorosis: Terminal leaf yellowing. Correction: Foliar spray of 0.5% Ferrous Sulphate + 0.1% citric acid.

biofertilizers_recommended: Rhizobium + PSB @ 250 g/10 kg seed inoculation.
